content: Tsa'caen tsu Chigaja pa'cco sefacco andeve'qque agattoemba osha'cho tsani jincho'chove nanitsse agattoen.
Nanimba septimo a'tave dasi tsequi a'ta pa'cco tise sema'bama nanimba ño'fa.
Tsa'camba “Septimo a'taja ña ñotssi a'ta tsu” qquen supa Chigaja “Tsa a'taja sema'ma'quia a'ta tsu” qquen su. Nane tsequi a'ta Chigaja osha'cho agattoen'cho sema'bama nanimba ño'fapa tsa'caen su.
Edéni'su jombachoccu
Qquen tsu Chiga agattoen'choja, ma'caen tiseja ande sefaccoma'qque agattoen: Na'su Chiga tsa'caen ande, sefaccove'qque agattointeja
toya tsu ande'su te'ta, ande'su shoshovi'qque sho'yombi. Nane Na'su Chiga toya unjima moembisi tsu toya sho'yombi. Toya'caen a'i'qque toya can'jembi andema semañe.
Tsa'ma ccuttopa'si ande'ye sombopa ansundepa surunome dapa pa'cco andema tssipoen.
Tsa'caen tssipoensi Na'su Chigaja andema mandyiccoemba a'ive ñoña. Ñoñamba tsofatunga tise qquendya'pama ufapa tisema qquendyaen. Tsa'caen qquendyaen a'imajan.
Tsomba Na'su Chigaja coejechiga sombo'jeni Edén andenga osha'cho ñotssiama jombachoccunga jon. Jomba tseni tsu Tise agattoen'cho a'ima ccutsian.

Tsomba ande'ye Chigaja osha'choma shoyo'yaen. Nane osha'cho ñotsse atteqque'su quini'cco majama ñotssia anqque'suma shoyo'yaen. Toya'caen jombachoccumbe enttingenga tsu tiseja Cansiaña'cho Quini'ccoma sho'yaen. Faesu quini'ccoma'qque tseni sho'yaen. Tsa quini'ccoma an'da majan ñotssia, majan egave atesuya'cho.
Edén andene tsu na'enjan sombo jombachoccuma tssipoeñe. Sombopa tsu cuatro na'eme da.
Fae'ccoma tsu Pisónme inisian. Tsaja pa'cco Havila andema shoquendí ja'je'cho. Cori tsu jin tsa andeni.
Tsa corija ñotssi tsu. Toya'caen bedelio patu, ónice patu'qque tseni jin.
Faesu na'emanda tsu Gihónme inisian. Tsaja pa'cco Cus andema shoquendí ja'je'cho.
Faesu na'ema tsu Tigrisve inisian. Tsa na'en ja'je'choja Asiria joccani chiga sombo'jefa tsu. Toya'caen faesu na'ema tsu Eufratesve inisian.
Tsonsi Na'su Chigaja a'ima Edéni'su jombachoccunga ccutsian cuintsu tsama semamba coiraye.
Ccutsiamba a'ima su: “Poiyi'cco jombachoccu'su tetachoma qui añe osha.
Tsa'ma tsa ñotssia, egama atesuya'cho quini'cco'su tetachomajan anjama. Nane maqui a'ta tsama an'da qui paya.”
Tsomba Na'su Chigaja asi'ttaemba in'jan: “Ñotssimbi tsu tsandie tisuyi can'jeñe. Tisema fuite'suve gi ñoñaña tisia'can'me cuintsu tisei'ccu fae'ngae canseye.”

Tsa'caen in'jamba Na'su Chigaja tayo andema osha'cho ande'ye jacanqque'su, sefa'ye chhajeqque'su chhiririave'qque ñoña'choma tsandienga i. Ipa tsandiema manda cuintsu osha'chove inisiañe. Tsa'cansi osha'cho tsu tsandie tise'pama inisianqquia'caen tsangae jincho.
Nane tsandie tsu poiyi'cco aiña'cho vaura'can'ma sefani'su chhiririama, tsampini canseqque'suma'qque inisian. Tsa'ma ñoa'me tsandiei'ccu fae'ngae cansepa fuite'suve me'i'on.
Tsa'cansi Na'su Chiga tisema anaesi tsandieja ana. Ana'jensi Chigaja tsandie utuccu'su tsu'ttama somboemba ttonoi'ccu changoma picco.
Utuccu'su tsu'ttama Na'su Chigaja pushesuve ñoña. Ñoñamba tsandienga afe.
Afesi tsandieja pushesuma attepa su: “¡Va tsu ñoa'me ña tsu'ttai'ccu, ña ttonoi'ccu ñama'caen ñoña'cho! Tisemanda gi inisiaña pushesuve. Nane Chigaja tsandie'suma tise've isusi ‘pushesu’ tsu.”
Tsa'cansi tsu ja'ño tsandieja tise yaya, tise mamama catipa tise pushei'ccu can'jen'faya. Nane tsa dos tsu fae a'ia'caeñi da'faya.
Toya'caen tsa'caen ñoñasi tsandie, pushesu'qque chu'cco can'jen'fa. Tsa'ma tsa'caen can'jen'ma ansangembe'yi can'jen'fa.
